proposed_scope.included: 19 model-ready targets across 15 packages plus preview catalog, target provenance, license, and documentation
proposed_scope.full_release_follow_up: A full corpus release requires a separate manifest, root hash, backend pilot, validation, and immutable version.

required_owner_choices.object_backend_and_quota: ordinary-git on GitHub; 211,008,093-byte preview with one documented >50 MiB warning; no LFS objects
required_owner_choices.partial_blocked_target_presentation: must preserve exact readiness status and say not an accepted benchmark

storage_note: Ordinary Git is technically permitted for this preview because the largest file is below 100 MiB; files above 50 MiB require a documented warning/clone-readback check. LFS or object storage is optional but, if selected, must pass a pointer/object readback pilot.
credential_handling: Credentials must be supplied through an authorized secure channel and must never be written to this repository.
